'''Mohamed Jamal Deen''' {{Post-nominals|country=CAN|CM}} is an Indo-Guyanese <ref>Article {{cite news|title=Canada's top honor for Guyanese-born professor|publisher=Indo Caribbean World|date=August 16, 2006|url=http://www.indocaribbeanworld.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.guyanaconsulate.com/awards_2008winners.pdf |title=Archived copy |access-date=2008-06-26 |archive-date=2020-03-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200319190049/http://www.guyanaconsulate.com/awards_2008winners.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://dailynews.mcmaster.ca/story.cfm?id=5455|publisher=McMaster Daily News|title=Engineering professor receives academic excellence award|date=June 2, 2008|access-date=April 13, 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110521213019/http://dailynews.mcmaster.ca/story.cfm?id=5455|archive-date=May 21, 2011|url-status=dead|df=mdy-all}}</ref> professor and Senior [[Canada Research Chair]] in Information Technology at [[McMaster University]] in [[Hamilton, Ontario]], Canada. He is also the Director of the Micro- and Nano-Systems Laboratory.<ref name="autogenerated1">{{cite news|url=http://dailynews.mcmaster.ca/story.cfm?id=4689|publisher=McMaster Daily News|title=Micro- and Nano-Systems Lab receives $4.25 million from Ontario Research Fund|date=May 11, 2007|access-date=March 6, 2008|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070519041029/http://dailynews.mcmaster.ca/story.cfm?id=4689|archive-date=May 19, 2007|url-status=dead|df=mdy-all}}</ref> His research specialty are in the broad areas of electrical engineering and applied physics, for which he was recognized in 2019 by an appointment to the [[Order of Canada]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Dr. Mohamed Jamal Deen |url=https://www.gg.ca/en/honours/recipients/146-16698 |website=The Governor General of Canada |publisher=Office of the Secretary to the Governor General |access-date=6 September 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260610165508/https://www.gg.ca/en/honours/recipients/146-16698 |archive-date=10 June 2026}}</ref>

==Education==
Deen <ref>See article {{cite news|title=Dr. Deen bags Canada's top engineering honor|publisher=Indo Caribbean World|date=July 4, 2007|url=http://www.indocaribbeanworld.com/archives/2007/july_4_2007/community.htm|archive-date=October 4, 2011|access-date=March 6, 2008|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111004133410/http://www.indocaribbeanworld.com/archives/2007/july_4_2007/community.htm|url-status=dead}}</ref> completed a [[Bachelor of Science|B.Sc.]] degree in Mathematics and Physics at the [[University of Guyana]] in 1978, winning both the Chancellor's Medal <ref>See article in Guyana Chronicle, '''U.G. top two students''', Thursday January 4, 1979 in archives at www.guyanachronicle.com</ref> as well as the Dr. Irving Adler's Prize for being the best mathematics student. After working for two years at the University of Guyana,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.uog.edu.gy |title=University of Guyana |publisher=Uog.edu.gy |date=2015-11-03 |accessdate=2016-01-29}}</ref> he won the prestigious Fulbright scholarship <ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.laspau.harvard.edu/programs/prog_fb_facultydev.htm |title=- LASPAU |accessdate=29 January 2016 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160204073738/http://www.laspau.harvard.edu/programs/prog_fb_facultydev.htm |archivedate=4 February 2016 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://fulbright.state.gov/|title=Fulbright - Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs|accessdate=29 January 2016|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20121106221135/http://fulbright.state.gov/|archivedate=6 November 2012}}</ref> (under the Latin American program) to undertake graduate work at [[Case Western Reserve University]]. Later as a doctoral student, he won an American Vacuum Society <ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.avs.org/|title=AVS - Home|publisher=|accessdate=29 January 2016}}</ref> Scholarship. He completed his doctoral dissertation on the design and modeling of a new CARS (coherent anti-Stokes scattering) spectroscopy system for dynamic temperature measurements and combustion optimization in rocket and jet engines,<ref>See article {{cite journal|last1=Deen|first1=M. Jamal|last2=Thompson|first2=E. D.|title=Design and simulated performance of a CARS spectrometer for dynamic temperature measurements using electronic heterodyning|journal=Applied Optics|doi=10.1364/AO.28.001409|pmid=20548671|volume=28|issue=7|pages=1409–1416|year=1989|bibcode = 1989ApOpt..28.1409D }}</ref><ref name=biography>{{cite web|url=http://www.ece.mcmaster.ca/~jamal/Biography.htm|title=Biography|publisher=|accessdate=29 January 2016}}</ref> in 1985.

==Research and publication==
Deen has published extensively on microelectronics/nanoelectronics and optoelectronics including works on the [[noise (electronics)|noise]] in electronic devices.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ece.mcmaster.ca/~jamal/|title=M. Jamal Deen|publisher=|accessdate=29 January 2016}}</ref> As stated by [[McMaster University]] on "Faces of Innovation",<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.mcmaster.ca/research/faces/faces_deen.htm|title=Research at McMaster University|publisher=|accessdate=29 January 2016}}</ref> Jamal Deen is generally regarded as "A leading expert in modeling, design and applications of modern advanced semiconductor devices and circuits". {{Citation needed|date=April 2018}} He has co-edited two research monographs ''Low Temperature Electronics: Physics, Devices, Circuits, and Applications''<ref>{{cite book|year=2001|title=Low Temperature Electronics: Physics, Devices, Circuits, and Applications|author=Edmundo A. Gutierrez-D|author2=Jamal Deen |author3=Cor Claeys |publisher=Academic Press |isbn=978-0-12-310675-9}}</ref> and ''CMOS RF Modeling, Characterization and Applications''
<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.worldscibooks.com/engineering/4921.html|title=CMOS RF Modeling, Characterization and Applications|publisher= World Scientific|accessdate=29 January 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120520113723/http://www.worldscibooks.com/engineering/4921.html|archive-date=20 May 2012|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Honours==
Deen has been honoured many times <ref name=biography/> by his peers through his election to the highest status in professional societies and national academies. In 2019 he was appointed to the Order of Canada in recognition of his contributions to the fields of electrical engineering and applied physics.<ref name="Fanfair">{{cite journal |last1=Fanfair |first1=Ron |title=Canadian scholar elected to the Chinese Academy of Sciences |journal=Sharenews |date=2020 |volume=42 |issue=19 |page=2 |url=https://www.sharenews.com/december-19-2019-january-8-2020-vol-42-no-19/ |accessdate=29 February 2020}}</ref> The following year he was elected to the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="Fanfair" />

* Fellow of the Royal Society of Canada.<ref>[http://www.rsc.ca/files/media/newfellows/new_fellows_2006_citations.pdf Rsc Src<!-- Bot generated title -->] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110718191706/http://www.rsc.ca/files/media/newfellows/new_fellows_2006_citations.pdf |date=July 18, 2011 }}</ref><ref>[http://www.canadian-universities.net/News/Press-Releases/August_8_2006_Professors_elected_to_Royal_Society_of_Canada.html Professors elected to Royal Society of Canada - Canadian University Press Releases<!-- Bot generated title -->] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080129234640/http://www.canadian-universities.net/News/Press-Releases/August_8_2006_Professors_elected_to_Royal_Society_of_Canada.html |date=2008-01-29 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://ewh.ieee.org/reg/7/news/2007/jan2007.htm|title=IEEE Canada Newsletter|publisher=|access-date=29 January 2016}}</ref>
* Fellow of the [[Canadian Academy of Engineering]] in 2007.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://ewh.ieee.org/reg/7/news/2007/dec2007.htm |title=Engineering Professor Inducted Fellow of The Canadian Academy of Engineering |newspaper=IEEE Canada Newsletter |publisher=[[IEEE]] Canada |date=December 2007 |access-date=April 21, 2011}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.acad-eng-gen.ca/e/members.cfm |title=Member List |publisher=[[Canadian Academy of Engineering]] |accessdate=April 21, 2011 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110706164351/http://www.acad-eng-gen.ca/e/members.cfm |archivedate=July 6, 2011 }}</ref>
* Fellow of the [[Indian National Academy of Engineering]].<ref>[http://www.inae.org/fellows_inae.htm Members/Fellows<!-- Bot generated title -->] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080308065854/http://www.inae.org/fellows_inae.htm |date=2008-03-08 }}</ref>
* Fellow of the [[Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.theinstitute.ieee.org/portal/cms_docs/tionline/timar03.pdf|title=IEEE - The Institute|publisher=|accessdate=29 January 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110727093411/http://www.theinstitute.ieee.org/portal/cms_docs/tionline/timar03.pdf|archive-date=27 July 2011|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>[http://www.micronetrd.ca/Newsletters/Micronet_news/2002_news/Dec2002.html Micronet.news December 2002<!-- Bot generated title -->] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041226123743/http://www.micronetrd.ca/Newsletters/Micronet_news/2002_news/Dec2002.html |date=2004-12-26 }}</ref>
* Fellow of the [[Engineering Institute of Canada]].<ref>[http://www.eic-ici.ca/english/tour/cit04/citdeen.html cittrofimenkov<!-- Bot generated title -->] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071009141022/http://www.eic-ici.ca/english/tour/cit04/citdeen.html |date=2007-10-09 }}</ref>
* Fellow of the [[Electrochemical Society]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.electrochem.org/awards/ecs/ecs_awards.htm#h |title=ECS Society Awards<!-- Bot generated title --> |access-date=2008-03-06 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150721022447/http://www.electrochem.org/awards/ecs/ecs_awards.htm#h |archive-date=2015-07-21 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* Fellow of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://php.aaas.org/about/aaas_fellows/list.php |title=AAAS - The World's Largest General Scientific Society - |accessdate=29 January 2016 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20140115191304/http://php.aaas.org/about/aaas_fellows/list.php |archivedate=15 January 2014 }}</ref>
* Honorary Member of the [[World Innovation Foundation]], the foundation's highest honor.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.thewif.org.uk/home.php?xy=1600&pl=linux%20i686%20(x86_64)|title=Welcome to the World Innovation Foundation website|publisher=|accessdate=29 January 2016}}</ref>
* Fellow of the [[American Physical Society]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.eng.mcmaster.ca/news/news2008/deen_APS_fellowship.html|title=APS Fellowship an Engineering First at McMaster|date=December 22, 2008|publisher=McMaster Daily News|access-date=January 22, 2009|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110717072208/http://www.eng.mcmaster.ca/news/news2008/deen_APS_fellowship.html|archive-date=July 17, 2011|url-status=dead|df=mdy-all}}</ref>
